**Where it's opened**
- `GameConsoleComponent.openInventory()` at `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237` calls `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, …)`.
- It passes `panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel'` and `maxHeight: '90vh'`.
- The `afterClosed()` subscriber is an empty no-op.

**Data passed**
- `data` is an `InventoryDialogData`, `{ characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }`.
- The type is defined at `inventory.component.ts:19`.
- The dialog reads it through `inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA)` at line 41.
- Every API call below uses `characterId`. The calls I found in `inventory.component.ts` don't use `sessionId`.

**API calls**
All of these go through `GameApiService` (`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`):

| Call (in `inventory.component.ts`) | HTTP request | When |
|---|---|---|
| `getInventory(characterId)` (line 59) | `GET /api/character/:characterId`, keeping only `inventory` from the response | On init |
| `equipItem(characterId, item_id, newEquipped)` (line 77) | `PATCH /api/character/:characterId/equip` with body `{ itemId, equipped }` | Equip or unequip a weapon or armor |
| `dropItem(characterId, item_id)` (line 123) | `DELETE /api/character/:characterId/inventory/:itemId` | Drop, after `confirm()` |
| `dropItem(characterId, item_id)` (line 150) | Same `DELETE` | Use Potion, which consumes one unit |

**Known issues** (from `inventory.component.md`)
- Potion healing rolls the `heal` dice in the browser and sets HP locally only. It isn't saved, and it breaks the rule that the Worker owns all dice (bugs.md B-05).
- The dialog opens at the bottom of the page instead of centered (bugs.md B-14).
